patthana3.14:141.1: pe . . . garuṃ katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca
patthana3.14:142.1: lobho ca uppajjanti. 7. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca . . . Ārammaṇādhipati:-- diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagate khandhe ca
patthana3.14:143.1: katvā ganthasampayuttā khandhā uppajjanti . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). Diṭṭhigata. . . katvā diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho uppajjati . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ).
patthana3.14:144.1: Diṭṭhigata- . . . katvā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca uppajjanti. 1. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa
patthana3.14:155.1: dhammassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (a) Purimā purimā ganthasampayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). (b) Purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (c) Purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa, ganthasampayuttā khandhā vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). (d) Purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. (e) Purimā purimā domanassasahagatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 4. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthavippayuttassa . . . Purimo purimo diṭṭhigatavippayutto lobho pacchimassa pacchimassa diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimaṃ purimaṃ domanassa sahagataṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimā purimā diṭṭhigatavippayuttā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo. 5. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa . . . (a) Purimo . . . pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ diṭṭhigatevippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (b) Purimaṃ purimaṃ paṭighaṃ pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . Āvajjanā ganthasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 6. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthasampayuttassa ca . . . Purimo . . . khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Purimaṃ . . . khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. Āvajjanā diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 7. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca . . . (a) Purimā . . . khandhā lobho ca pacchimānaṃ . . . khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. (b) Purimā . . . khandhā ca paṭighañ ca pacchimānaṃ . . . khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). (c) Purimā . . . khandhā ca lobho ca pacchimassa . . . (d) Purimā . . . paṭighañ ca pacchimassa pacchimassa paṭighassa anantarapaccayena paccayo. (e) Diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ ca vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). (f) Purimā . . . lobho ca pacchimānaṃ . . . (g) Purimā . . . khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca anantarapaccayena paccayo. 1. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa samanantara- . . . sahajāta- . . . aññamañña- . . . nissaya- . . . upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇūpanissayo, anantarūpanissayo, pakatūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ) Ganthasampayuttā khandhā ganthavippayuttānaṃ . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). Ganthasampayuttā khandhā diṭṭhigatavippa yuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhā naṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthavippayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti . . . pe . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti, mānaṃ jappeti . . . Sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . paññaṃ, rāgaṃ dosaṃ, mohaṃ, mānaṃ, patthanaṃ, kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ . . . utuṃ bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, . . . pe . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti . . . pāṇaṃ hanati . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati, saddhā . . . pe . . . paññā rāgo . . . pe . . . patthanā senāsanaṃ . . . saddhāya . . . paññāya rāgassa dosassa mohassa mānassa patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 5. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa dhammassa . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . pāññaṃ rāgaṃ . . . pe . . . mānaṃ patthanaṃ senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati. Saddhā . . . pe . . . senāsanaṃ rāgassa dosassa mohassa mānassa diṭṭhiyā patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 6. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthasampayuttassa ca . . . (tīṇi). Saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti, sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . paññaṃ rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ mānaṃ patthanaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati . . . pe . . . saṃghaṃ bhindati, saddhā . . . pe . . . paññā rāgo doso moho māno patthanā senāsanaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 7. Ganthasampayutto ca ganthavippayutto ca . . . Ārammaṇūpanissayo . . . pe . . . Pakatūpanissayo:-- diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā lobhañ ca khandhā ca paṭighañ ca ganthasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). Diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ ca ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa ca paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (mūlaṃ pucchitabbaṃ). Diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ ca diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 4. Ganthavippayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, vatthupurejātaṃ. Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ:-- cakkhuṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato vipassati, assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthavippayutto rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi vicikicchā uddhaccaṃ domanassaṃ uppajjati: dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa . . . Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa, vatthu ganthavippayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ diṭṭhigatavippayuttassa lobhassa ca paṭighassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 5. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthasampayuttassa . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha ganthasampayutto rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu ganthasampayuttānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo. 6. Ganthavippayutto . . . ganthasampayuttassa ca . . . Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ . . . pe . . . vatthuṃ ārabbha diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatā khandhā ca lobho ca domanassasahagatā khandhā ca paṭighañ ca uppajjanti. Vatthupurejātaṃ:-- vatthu diṭṭhigatavippayuttalobhasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ lobhassa ca domanassasahagatānaṃ khandhānaṃ paṭighassa ca purejātapaccayena paccayo. 2. Ganthasampayutto dhammo ganthavippayuttassa dhammassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo . . . (ekaṃ). 4. Ganthavippayutto
